_meta.source: CUI Wah Campus Official Notices & Announcements

announcements.title: Fall 2026 (FA26) Admissions Are Now Open
announcements.summary: Applications for Fall 2026 (FA26) semester are now being accepted. The last date to apply is August 11, 2026. Apply at admissions.comsats.edu.pk
announcements.details: CUI Wah Campus has officially opened admissions for the Fall 2026 (FA26) semester. Students seeking admission to BS, MS, and PhD programs must submit their applications online via the official CUI admissions portal by August 11, 2026. Late applications will NOT be entertained.

announcements.title: Remaining NTS Entry Test Date for FA26: August 16, 2026
announcements.summary: IMPORTANT: The July test has passed. The ONLY REMAINING NTS entry test for Fall 2026 (FA26) is on August 16, 2026.
announcements.details: CUI Fall 2026 (FA26) Applicants Note: The July test has been completed. There is ONLY ONE REMAINING NTS entry test scheduled for August 16, 2026. All pending applicants must register and appear on August 16, 2026. NTS registration fee is Rs. 800.

announcements.title: Fall 2026 (FA26) 1st Merit List to Display on August 18
announcements.summary: The 1st merit list for Fall 2026 (FA26) admissions will be displayed on the admission portal on August 18, 2026.
announcements.details: Selected candidates will be notified via the admission portal and registered email. Candidates must download their offer letter and deposit dues within the specified deadline to confirm admission.

announcements.title: Fall 2026 (FA26) Fee Structure Announced
announcements.summary: Updated fee structures for all programs have been announced for Fall 2026 (FA26). Engineering: Rs. 193,500 at admission. CS Programs: Rs. 187,500. Management/Humanities: Rs. 175,500.
announcements.details: The Finance Division has released the official fee structure for Fall 2026 (FA26). Fees are payable at the beginning of each semester. Hostel (Rs. 55,000/semester) and transport (Rs. 35,000/semester) charges are separate.

announcements.title: Fall 2026 (FA26) Academic Calendar Published
announcements.summary: Fall 2026 (FA26) classes commence September 7, 2026. Mid-term exams: November 2026. Final exams: January 2027.
announcements.details: Key dates for Fall 2026 (FA26): Classes Begin: September 7, 2026 | Add/Drop Period: First 2 weeks | Mid-term Exams: 2nd to 3rd week of November 2026 | Final Exams: 2nd week of January 2027 | Result Announcement: January/February 2027.

announcements.title: HEC Need-Based Scholarship Applications Open
announcements.summary: HEC Need-Based Scholarship applications are open for newly admitted students for Fall 2026 (FA26). Apply through the Financial Aid Office.
announcements.details: Newly admitted undergraduate students from low-income families can apply for HEC Need-Based Scholarships. Required documents include income certificate, B-form, and admission letter. Contact financialaid@ciitwah.edu.pk for details.

announcements.title: Hostel Allocation for Fall 2026 (FA26) — Apply Early
announcements.summary: Hostel seats for Fall 2026 (FA26) are limited and allocated on first come first served basis. Contact the Hostel Office immediately after receiving admission offer.
announcements.details: CUI Wah Campus hostel has limited capacity. Newly admitted students are urged to contact the Hostel Warden Office (+92-51-9047445) immediately upon receiving their admission offer letter to secure a hostel seat.

announcements.title: Updated Attendance Policy for 2026-27
announcements.summary: Students must maintain a minimum 75% attendance in each course to be eligible to sit in final examinations.
announcements.details: As per the updated academic policy for 2026-27, all students must maintain at least 75% attendance in each enrolled course. Students falling below 60% attendance will be debarred from final exams. Medical exemptions require documentation from a registered physician and HOD approval.
